system-on-chip-architecture--program-sta.title: condition flags in an ARM program status word
rows: the result is negative, i.e. its top bit is 1
an add carries out, or a subtract does not borrow
a signed result overflows the register width
the core is executing Thumb-state instructions
system-on-chip-architecture--program-sta.note: A conditional branch is only a test on these flags, so one compare can drive BNE, BCS or BVS without touching the ALU again.

system-on-chip-architecture--load-store-.title: adding two memory values the load-store way
lines: ADD   r4, r0, r2      ; r4 = r0 + r2      register operands only
system-on-chip-architecture--load-store-.note: Only LDR and STR reach memory, which is what lets every instruction keep the same length and a fixed decode cost.

system-on-chip-architecture--bimodal-bra.title: 2-bit saturating counter transitions
system-on-chip-architecture--bimodal-bra.note: The extra bit provides hysteresis: one loop exit does not flip a strongly taken branch, so a single anomaly is absorbed.

system-on-chip-architecture--amba.title: AMBA protocol family
rows: multi-master with a central arbiter and mux
separate address and data channels, outstanding bursts
AXI plus hardware cache coherency between masters
coherent, scalable mesh for many cores
system-on-chip-architecture--amba.note: The family trades complexity for parallelism: APB has no bursts, AHB grants one master at a time, and AXI overlaps address with data.

system-on-chip-architecture--axi.title: AXI read burst over separate channels

steps.label: ARADDR, ARLEN = 3 on the read address channel
next ARADDR issued before the data returns

system-on-chip-architecture--axi.note: Address and data travel on different channels, so the master can queue the next burst while the current one is still arriving.

system-on-chip-architecture--direct-mapp.title: splitting an address into tag, index and offset
lines: /* 32 KiB cache, 64 B lines: 512 lines, 6 offset bits, 9 index bits */
system-on-chip-architecture--direct-mapp.note: The index selects the only line the block may occupy, so lookup is one equality test on the tag instead of a search.

system-on-chip-architecture--tomasulo-s-.title: Tomasulo issue and wake-up
lines: if regstat[src1] == 0: rs.Vj = reg[src1]  else: rs.Qj = regstat[src1]
if regstat[src2] == 0: rs.Vk = reg[src2]  else: rs.Qk = regstat[src2]
wait until Qj and Qk are both cleared, then execute
broadcast (station, result); every waiting station copies it into V
system-on-chip-architecture--tomasulo-s-.note: An unavailable operand becomes the name of the station that will produce it, so the instruction waits on a producer instead of a register.

system-on-chip-architecture--jpeg.title: JPEG encode stages and where quality is lost
rows: Cb and Cr at quarter resolution (4:2:0)
divide each coefficient by Q(u,v) and round
system-on-chip-architecture--jpeg.note: Only subsampling and quantisation discard information; everything after them is a reversible recoding of what survived.
